$doc: Home page animation spec — Webflow IX2 → GSAP conversion. Companion doc: home-animations.md. Raw decoded IX2 source: webflow-ix2-home.raw.json (extracted from webflow.028da9dc bundle).

meta.engine: Webflow IX2 (events + actionLists) + custom GSAP SplitText module (button letter roll)

riseBlurFade.description: The site's signature reveal. Used by actionLists a-10 / a-33 / a-48 / a-172 — identical motion, different delay.

curtainWipe.description: actionList a-32 — a solid overlay (.image-overly-bg, white or primary) collapses from height:100% to 0, revealing the image beneath (bottom-anchored, so it wipes upward).
curtainWipe.note: Height animation on a plain overlay div — acceptable here (no layout thrash, absolute-positioned). Alternative: scaleY with transform-origin:bottom for compositor-only.

scrollIntoView.description: IX2 SCROLL_INTO_VIEW with offset 0% == GSAP ScrollTrigger { start: 'top bottom', toggleActions: 'play none none none', once: true }

animations.name: Navbar recolor + light background on scroll

webflow.raw: PAGE_SCROLL continuous, smoothing 60. Keyframes 0%→3% of page scroll: .nav-light-bg opacity 0→1; link/search text color white→#1c0701; logo + dropdown icons filter invert 0%→100%; burger lines white→black.

gsap.note: 3% of page height ≈ first ~150px. Scrubbed in Webflow; a state toggle at ~50px is a faithful simplification.
gsap.example: ScrollTrigger.create({ start: 50, onUpdate: none, toggleClass: { targets: header, className: 'is-scrolled' } }) — colors via CSS transition

animations.implementation: React scroll listener toggles text-white→text-foreground, logo brightness(0), glass bg fade (500ms CSS transitions).

animations.name: Nav link icon roll on hover

webflow.raw: MOUSE_OVER: child .clip-icon-wrapper y 0→-100% (400ms inOutQuint). MOUSE_OUT: back to 0.

animations.implementation: CSS group-hover translate on duplicated icon (hero category links) / letter roll on nav links.

animations.name: Hero heading/description rise-in (loading)

webflow.raw: SCROLL_INTO_VIEW at top of page (fires on load): rise 20px + blur 3px + fade, 1000ms, delay 300ms, inOutQuart.

animations.implementation: hero-client.tsx load timeline with blur channel (y20+blur3→0, 1s power3.inOut at 0.3s).

animations.name: Hero category links slide from left (loading, desktop)
animations.implementation: hero-client.tsx: x−20+blur→0, 0.7s power1.inOut at 0.15s, stagger 0.1.

animations.name: Hero CTA button rise-in (loading)
animations.implementation: Part of the .hero-reveal-text stagger in the load timeline.

animations.name: Hero image zoom + drift on scroll out (scrub)

webflow.raw: SCROLLING_IN_VIEW continuous, smoothing ~60. Progress 50%→90% of hero's scroll journey: .hero-image-absolute scale 1→1.1, y 0→-5%.

gsap.example: gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: heroEl, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.6 } }).to(img, { scale: 1.1, yPercent: -5, ease: 'none' }, 0.5)
gsap.note: Keyframes at 50% and 90% — hold flat for first half, then ramp. Use position parameter 0.5 on a 1s-long ease:none timeline.

animations.implementation: hero-client.tsx scrubbed timeline (scrub 0.6) on .hero-bg-image: hold to 50%, scale 1.1 / y −5% by 90%.

animations.name: Subtitle rise-in on scroll
animations.implementation: Reveal island ([data-reveal] stagger).

animations.name: Tab words cascade in (one word at a time)

webflow.raw: Each .coffee-text-1…7: from y20/opacity0/blur5 → in over 300ms each, delays 300/500/600/700/800/900/1000ms — sequential word cascade.

animations.implementation: collection-tabs-client.tsx: [data-tab-word] fromTo y20/blur5 → in, 0.3s each, stagger 0.1, delay 0.3, ScrollTrigger once.

animations.name: Tab content late rise-in

webflow.raw: riseBlurFade 1000ms delay 1000ms inOutQuart — waits for the tab-word cascade.

animations.implementation: collection-tabs-client.tsx builds a first-scroll timeline: tab words cascade, then [data-card] content rises late at the 1s mark; tab changes still re-stagger cards.

animations.name: Product photo zoom + name dim on hover

webflow.raw: MOUSE_OVER: .product-photo scale 1→1.08 (600ms inOutQuad); .product-name opacity 1→0.7. MOUSE_OUT: reverse (500/600ms).

gsap.note: Pure-CSS equivalent is fine: transition transform 600ms / opacity 600ms on group-hover.

animations.implementation: CSS group-hover: photo scale 1.08 (500ms) + name opacity 0.7 (500ms).

animations.name: Button label letter-by-letter roll (all pill CTAs)

webflow.raw: Custom code splits .button-text into .gsap_split_word/.gsap_split_letter via SplitText; on hover the top copy's letters translate up and the bottom copy's letters roll in, staggered per letter.

gsap.example: const split = new SplitText(topText, { type: 'chars' }); gsap.to(split.chars, { yPercent: -150, stagger: 0.02, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power4.inOut' }) + mirrored tween on bottom copy
gsap.note: SplitText is a Club GSAP plugin; a manual span-per-char split achieves the same.

animations.implementation: RollLink manually splits labels into character spans and runs a CSS dual-copy yPercent-style roll with 20ms per-letter delays.

animations.name: Background image zoom-settle 1.3→1
animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-zoom]: scale 1.3→1, 1.5s power1.out.

animations.name: White curtain wipes off the image
animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-curtain]: bg-background overlay height 100%→0, 1.2s power1.inOut.

animations.name: Center content rise-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Subtitle / heading / paragraphs / button rise-in

webflow.raw: riseBlurFade per element, each with own trigger.

animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Video block fade-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island (adds y/blur too — close enough).

animations.name: Divider line draws left→right

gsap.note: Wrap divider in overflow-hidden. scaleX with origin-left is the cheaper equivalent.

animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-line]: scaleX 0→1 origin-left, 1.3s power1.out.

animations.name: Advantages list slides up (desktop) / items rise (mobile)

webflow.raw: Desktop: whole list translateY 0→-100% (own height) over 800ms inOutQuint — list sits below its slot and slides up. Mobile: each .advantage-item does riseBlurFade (a-48).

gsap.example: gsap.from(list, { yPercent: 100, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power4.inOut', scrollTrigger: {...} }) — or stagger items: gsap.from(items, { y: 20, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(3px)', stagger: 0.1 })
gsap.note: Desktop uses the Webflow-style slot slide; mobile keeps the item stagger.

animations.implementation: Reveal island handles [data-reveal-slide-list] as yPercent 100→0 on desktop and [data-reveal-slide-item] rise-blur-fade stagger on mobile.

animations.name: Background image slow vertical drift (ken burns)

webflow.raw: On enter: .absolute-image starts scale 1.2 / y -5%, then y -5%→+5% over 10000ms inOutQuad (one-shot).

gsap.note: Scrub variant (yPercent tied to section progress) is the modern take and avoids a 10s timer.

animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-kenburns]: scale 1.2 fixed, y −5%→5% over 10s, once.

animations.name: Label / heading / paragraph / step texts rise-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Step circle draws in two halves + number fades

webflow.raw: Per .work-item: .circle-outline-wrap.top width 0→100% (600ms delay 400 inOutQuad); .step-number opacity 0→1 (500ms delay 650); .circle-outline-wrap.bottom width 0→100% (600ms delay 1010 outQuad).

gsap.example: tl.to(top, { width: '100%', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.inOut' }, 0.4).to(num, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, 0.65).to(bottom, { width: '100%', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.out' }, 1.01)
gsap.note: Simpler modern equivalent: SVG circle stroke-dashoffset draw, or clip-path reveal on a single border circle.

animations.implementation: SVG circle stroke draw via [data-reveal-draw] (pathLength=1, dashoffset 1→0, 1.2s, delay 0.4) + number rise via [data-reveal].

animations.name: Primary-colored curtain wipes off portrait
animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-curtain] with bg-primary overlay.

animations.name: Label / quote / author rise-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Label / heading / paragraph rise-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Features grid + right image column fade-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Cup images slide in from the right
animations.implementation: Reveal island [data-reveal-right]: x100+fade→0, 1s power3.out, stagger 0.12.

animations.name: Slider row rise-in + decorative squares fade
animations.implementation: Reveal island.

animations.name: Square image flips (rotateY) on hover

webflow.raw: MOUSE_OVER: .image-cover rotateY→180deg (500ms), then back to 0 (500ms) — full flip.

gsap.example: gsap.fromTo(img, { rotationY: 0 }, { rotationY: 180, duration: 0.5, yoyo: true, repeat: 1 })

animations.implementation: reviews-image-flip.tsx wraps the image in a client island and uses contextSafe GSAP pointer-enter tween with repeat/yoyo.

animations.name: Arrow icon rolls through the button on hover

webflow.raw: MOUSE_OVER: child .slider-icon-wrapper x 0→±100% (400ms inOutQuint) — icon exits one side while absolute duplicate enters from the other. MOUSE_OUT: back.

gsap.note: CSS equivalent: duplicated icon + group-hover translate, like RollLink's text roll.

animations.implementation: CSS duplicated-icon roll-through on group-hover (400ms) in reviews-client.tsx.

animations.name: Slide change (arrows)

webflow.raw: Webflow slider, slide 60x ease, autoplay off.

gsap.note: Implemented as translateX track with CSS transition 500ms — equivalent.

animations.implementation: reviews-client.tsx index state + transform transition.

animations.name: Label / heading / address rise-in
animations.implementation: Reveal island (whole card reveals as one block).
